description: Canonical fixed MLS extension contract for Arkret v1 groups.

private_use_range.reference: RFC 9420 §17.6; IANA MLS Extension Types registry (private-use range)

extensions.name: required_capabilities
extensions.carries: The mls_governance_binding extension type 0xF1C0 is required for every Arkret group member.

extensions.name: mls_governance_binding
extensions.carries: Closed deterministic-CBOR map of five shared members {effective_scope, base_group_state_ref, previous_epoch, next_epoch, key_access_revision}; the Sidecar scope additionally requires participant_authority_digest and authority_stream_head, which every other scope MUST omit.
extensions.wire_encoding: RFC 8949 deterministic CBOR with definite lengths; key order equals the schema x-arkret-deterministic-cbor.map_key_order of all seven registered members
extensions.key_access_revision_contract: Monotonic unsigned 64-bit integer counter; it is never encoded or compared as a digest.
